description: K₃NaMoC₄(N₂O)₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pmna space group. There are two inequivalent K sites. In the first K site, K is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to four C and four N atoms. There are two shorter (2.92 Å) and two longer (3.19 Å) K-C bond lengths. There are two shorter (2.79 Å) and two longer (3.18 Å) K-N bond lengths. In the second K site, K is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to two equivalent C, four N, and two equivalent O atoms. Both K-C bond lengths are 3.12 Å. There are two shorter (2.85 Å) and two longer (3.04 Å) K-N bond lengths. Both K-O bond lengths are 2.70 Å. Na is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent N atoms. Both Na-N bond lengths are 2.21 Å. Mo is bonded in a distorted octahedral geometry to four C and two equivalent O atoms. There are two shorter (2.19 Å) and two longer (2.20 Å) Mo-C bond lengths. Both Mo-O bond lengths are 1.87 Å. There are two inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent K, one Mo, and one N atom. The C-N bond length is 1.18 Å. In the second C site, C is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to three K, one Mo, and one N atom. The C-N bond length is 1.19 Å. There are two inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to three K, one Na, and one C atom. In the second N site, N is bonded in a distorted square co-planar geometry to three K and one C atom. O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one K and one Mo atom.
